casus_belli.name: Imperial Reconquest
casus_belli.description:
Subjugate pretenders of the Empire. As rightful heirs of the Calradian Empire, any other kingdom that claims to be so ought to be subjugated and annexed by any means necessary.
Objective: Capture 1 or more fiefs of the enemy's culture.
casus_belli.war_declared_text: The {ATTACKER} is marching on {DEFENDER}! They claim to be the rightful heir of the Empire.

casus_belli.name: Imperial Superiority
casus_belli.description:
Subjugate barbarians with our Imperial might as the original Empire once did. Strength is the language that they understand.
Objective: Capture 1 or more fiefs of the enemy's culture.
casus_belli.war_declared_text: The {ATTACKER} is subjugating the barbarians of {DEFENDER}!

casus_belli.name: Cultural Liberation
casus_belli.description:
Liberate a fief of your people from the rule of foreigners. Any town or castle that is mostly composed by our culture is reason enough for us to rule it rather than foreigners.
Objective: Capture the selected target.
casus_belli.war_declared_text: The {ATTACKER} marches to war! {FIEF} is being liberated from the oppression of {DEFENDER}!

casus_belli.name: Great Raid
casus_belli.description:
Pillage and steal from our enemies as our ancestors did. Ruling their lands may be unviable, but it will not stop us from taking what we are owed by the rule of the strongest.
Objective: Raid 8 or more villages of the enemy's culture.
casus_belli.war_declared_text: The {ATTACKER} ride out for a great raid! {DEFENDER} towns and villages will be razed to the ground.

casus_belli.name: Invasion
casus_belli.description:
Invade a foreign kingdom as is the way of our ancestors. Seize their property and stablish our own rule.
Objective: Capture 1 or more fiefs of the enemy's culture.
casus_belli.war_declared_text: The {ATTACKER} is launching a large scale invasion on the {DEFENDER}!

casus_belli.name: Claim Fief
casus_belli.description:
Conquer a fief claimed by your realm. The benefactor of the conquest will always be the claimant, regardless of other ownership procedures.
Objective: Capture the selected target.
casus_belli.war_declared_text: The {ATTACKER} marches to war! {FIEF} is claimed by the {DEFENDER} as their rightful land!

casus_belli.name: Suppress Threat
casus_belli.description:
Liberate a fief of your people from the rule of foreigners. Any town or castle that is mostly composed by our culture is reason enough for us to rule it rather than foreigners.
Objective: Capture the selected target.
casus_belli.war_declared_text: The {ATTACKER} marches to war! They claim {DEFENDER} are an existential threat.

casus_belli.name: Rebellion
casus_belli.description: A rebellion war is fought by former radical groups over a realm, after their demand was rejected by their ruler. Rebels seek to enforce their demand by force.{newline}{newline}Objective: Survive as a rebellion for over 2 years with at least 1 fief.
casus_belli.war_declared_text: The {ATTACKER} marches to war! They fight in a civil war against the loyalists of the {DEFENDER}.

casus_belli.name: Holy War
casus_belli.description:
Wage holy war on a faith considered hostile to your own. Different faiths accept different types of holy wars at different piety costs.
Objective: Capture a fief.
casus_belli.war_declared_text: The {ATTACKER} marches to war! They wage holy war on the {DEFENDER}!

casus_belli.name: Divine Reclamation
casus_belli.description:
Wage holy war on a realm that holds a holy site or faith seat of your own faith. War success depends on capturing the specific selected target. Different faiths accept different types of holy wars at different piety costs.
Objective: Capture the selected target.
casus_belli.war_declared_text: The {ATTACKER} marches to war! The holy place of {FIEF} is to be reclaimed!
